description: Lists the questions to put to the person who knows the film, so that more of the plan can be checked. Each question uses the plan's own names, says which paths in the plan the answer fills in and which checks it unlocks, and says whether it blocks the assessment of a scene. Do not invent an answer to silence a question: when the honest answer is none, say so in the plan with a `none` declaration (shoot_plan_format explains). Input: plan, a dpl.plan/1 object sent inline. Output: dpl.missing/1. No AI model runs; nothing is stored. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.
